title: REQ · Reject failures and ids are handled by the client and AdminApp
summary: rejectExecution encodes the id and AdminApp shows a Reject failure message
description: Context: rejectExecution uses encodeURIComponent on the id and AdminApp shows actionError and actionDetail on non-401 failures. Reject-specific failure display and id encoding are untested. Desired behavior: both are asserted by unit tests.
acceptance_criteria: Given id 'a/b c', when rejectExecution is called, then fetch receives '/api/v1/admin/executions/a%2Fb%20c/reject'
Given Reject returns 500 {error:'boom'}, then the Execution region shows 'boom' in an alert
